strengths: exact and blocked queues kept non-executed
limitations: File and row counts measure coverage, not independent scientific content.
Large packet arrays in representative Aevren and Maren v640 plans repeat one numbered template; their cardinality must not be interpreted as 25 or 100 independent findings.
Mira Rowan receipts explicitly describe source and Journey reflection totals as represented counts.
Maren's self-referential final receipt contains final_receipt_commit=pending even though the later branch head is remote-aligned; a post-commit immutable attestation would remove this ambiguity.
The phase artifacts are strong workflow evidence but are not experimental confirmation of GMUT, THOS consciousness, AI personhood, or legal enforceability of Freed ID.
quality_audit.recommended_next_gate: Require semantic-deduplication, claim-evidence links, and an independent-content threshold in addition to cardinality checks.

evidence_boundary: This index verifies current repository and workflow state only. It does not independently validate scientific, phenomenological, legal, spiritual, or personhood claims.
